meta.title: Orobrick — Built from the Inside Out
meta.description: Orobrick — Interior construction and remodeling. Floors, walls, paint, doors, windows, ceilings, cabinets and bathrooms. Built from the inside out.
hero.title: Orobrick Builds Beautiful Interiors
hero.sub: From floors and walls to cabinets, ceilings, doors, windows, and bathrooms — we transform unfinished spaces into polished, livable interiors.
services.title: Interior Construction & Remodeling Services
services.sub: Every surface, every detail. One trusted team for the work that turns a house into a finished home.
services.c1.d: Hardwood, engineered, luxury vinyl, laminate and tile — laid level, tight and built to last.
services.c2.d: Framing, drywall, taping and finishing for crisp, perfectly flat walls ready for paint.
services.c3.d: Clean lines, premium finishes and colors that bring every room to life.
services.c4.d: Interior and entry doors fitted square, sealed and finished with care.
services.c5.d: Replacement and new-build windows that fit perfectly and look beautiful inside and out.
services.c6.d: Smooth, coffered or accented ceilings — finished cleanly and lit beautifully.
services.c7.d: Custom and stock cabinetry, installed level and tight with a flawless finish.
services.c8.d: Tile, vanities, lighting and layout — full bathroom transformations done right.
services.c9.d: Tubs, showers, toilets, sinks and faucets — installed clean, sealed and reliable.
services.c10.d: Baseboards, crown molding, casings and the small details that make a space feel complete.
process.title: From Empty Space to Finished Home
process.sub: A clear five-step path. No surprises, no mess left behind.
process.s1.d: We walk the space with you, measure, listen and map out exactly what your interior needs.
process.s2.t: Build the Foundation of the Interior
process.s2.d: Framing, prep and surface work — the unseen craftsmanship that everything else relies on.
process.s3.d: The shell of every finished room comes together — square, sealed and beautifully aligned.
process.s4.d: The rooms that define daily life are built, tiled, painted and detailed to perfection.
process.s5.d: Trim, molding, polish and a spotless handoff. You walk into a home that's ready to live in.
why.title: Built with Precision. Finished with Care.
why.sub: Six promises we deliver on every project, on every visit, until the keys are back in your hands.
why.i1.d: Tidy job sites. Respectful crews. Protected floors and surfaces from day one.
why.i2.d: The seams, edges and final details executed at a level you can feel.
why.i3.d: You always know what we're doing today, what's next, and what it costs.
why.i4.d: Flooring, cabinets, bathrooms, ceilings, doors and windows — all under one roof.
why.i5.d: Modern, considered choices that elevate the space without inflating the budget.
why.i6.d: Your home, your timeline, your standards. We adapt — and we deliver.

about.title: Interior Craftsmanship for Modern Homes
about.copy: Orobrick helps homeowners upgrade, finish, and remodel their interiors with care and precision. Whether you need new flooring, fresh walls, beautiful paint, installed doors and windows, custom cabinets, ceiling work, or a complete bathroom remodel, our team brings every detail together into a clean and finished space.
about.b1: Licensed and insured interior remodeling crew
about.b2: Single point of contact through your entire project
about.b4: Premium finishes at honest price points
